LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_01_DESC: 'Can you hear the noise outside? Today, you either become part of that sound or it swallows you whole. Your call.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_02_DESC: The bus windows are completely blacked out by flare smoke. The army of fans outside is rocking the chassis, and metallic thuds echo through the cabin.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_03_DESC: 'Look at that sweat-soaked shirt... Thousands of kids would give their lives for one chance to wear it. Go out and earn it!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_04_DESC: In the dressing room, you see those silver threads on your squad number. The fabric is ice cold, but your hands are burning with nerves.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_05_DESC: 'The opposition will try to rattle you with physicality early on. If you go down at the first touch, you won't survive the night. Stand tall!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_06_DESC: That deafening whistle from the stands is locked onto you during the warm-up. The stadium's electricity is crawling on your skin.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_07_DESC: 'Listen to me! If you don't wipe that fear out of your eyes, their defenders will tear you apart. This isn't a playground.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_08_DESC: The rhythmic 'click-clack' of metal studs on the tunnel concrete... War begins in a matter of seconds.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_09_DESC: 'I saw you in the warm-up; your shots are going straight at the keeper. If you don't test the corners, your name won't be on that scoreboard today.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_10_DESC: The pitch was heavily watered before kick-off. The scent of cut grass is so sharp it feels like your lungs are burning with every breath.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_11_DESC: 'Hand over your phone, kid. Until the whistle blows, your world is just that green rectangle. Don't let anyone clutter your head.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_12_DESC: The light at the end of the tunnel and that massive atmosphere... It feels like stepping into a gladiator's arena.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_13_DESC: 'If we get a penalty, don't pass the ball. You're the future of this club—take that responsibility now.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_14_DESC: The physio is applying that burning liniment to your calves. You can feel your muscles firing up like high-performance machinery.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_15_DESC: The roar of thousands of fans waiting at the airport gate still echoes in your ears, refusing to fade.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_16_DESC: 'The turf is harder than we expected. Watch your knees; don't go and get yourself crocked in the first challenge.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_17_DESC: Staring at the photos of legends in the corridor. Will your face be up there among them one day?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_18_DESC: During the anthem, the stadium acoustics are so powerful you can't even hear your own voice. You're lost in a wall of sound.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_19_DESC: 'The rival keeper is slow on goal kicks. Put him under constant pressure; force him into a blunder.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_20_DESC: A ball you struck during warm-ups accidentally hit the press box. The reporters caught the whole thing on camera.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_21_DESC: 'See that badge behind you? If you aren't ready to die for it today, take that shirt off right now!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_22_DESC: As your name is announced over the speakers, the roar briefly dips into a hush before exploding into thunder.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_23_DESC: The rival player standing next to you in the tunnel intentionally barged into your shoulder. There is pure venom in his eyes.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_24_DESC: Final checks in the dressing room. The Skipper adjusts everyone's collar, looking deep into their eyes.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_25_DESC: 'Today could be your day, son. Trust your instincts and put that ball in the back of the net.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_26_DESC: A stud on your boot came loose during the warm-up. Time is running out; do you risk it?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_27_DESC: A massive banner was unfurled in the stands. It's just your squad number, towering over the crowd.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_28_DESC: 'They're going to try and wind you up. They'll whisper things in your ear. Don't react—don't get booked!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_29_DESC: While waiting in the tunnel, a hand touches your shoulder. An old teammate says, 'Go make them proud.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_30_DESC: On the tactical board, there's a giant star next to your name. The entire strategy rests on your shoulders tonight.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_31_DESC: 'It's humid out there; save your energy for the second half. Avoid those wasted runs.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_32_DESC: The mascot child holding your hand during the ceremony whispers, 'Please score a goal for us, mate.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_33_DESC: Kick-off is delayed by 15 minutes due to the crowds outside. The wait in the dressing room is agonizing.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_34_DESC: 'Every drop of sweat today is a down payment on the tears of joy tomorrow. Give everything on that pitch!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_35_DESC: The commentator passes you in the corridor and says, 'Today, it’s either legend status or obscurity for you.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_36_DESC: A foreign object thrown from the stands strikes your shoulder during the warm-up. You feel a sharp sting.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_37_DESC: 'Look kid, the stands are crawling with scouts today. A top performance will take you to another level.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_38_DESC: Looking in the dressing room mirror, you've never seen that look of determination so clearly before.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_39_DESC: 'Tie those laces tight. One loose knot at the critical moment could change your entire destiny.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_40_DESC: Thousands of phone torches in the stands have turned the stadium into a giant galaxy. It's a visual masterpiece.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_41_DESC: 'The ref isn't having his best game today. Keep at him, hunt for the foul, put him under pressure.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_42_DESC: That shining trophy sitting at the tunnel entrance... You feel an overwhelming urge to touch it as you pass.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_43_DESC: 'Don't dwell on any mistakes today. We're a team, and we've got your back no matter what.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_44_DESC: The sound of your first shot hitting the post during the warm-up briefly silenced the entire arena.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_45_DESC: 'I read what you said in the interview. You've talked a big game. Hope you can back those words up on the pitch.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_46_DESC: The metallic clang of fans pounding on the security barriers outside sends your adrenaline through the roof.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_47_DESC: 'Your family is in the front row. You've got 90 minutes to make them proud.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_48_DESC: One final huddle in the dressing room. Everyone is locked shoulder-to-shoulder, roaring at the ceiling.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_49_DESC: As that familiar damp, cold tunnel air fills your lungs, you see the green pitch where destiny is written.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_50_DESC: 'Once that whistle blows, forget everything else. Focus only on what happens inside those white lines. Today, history is yours.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_51_DESC: The scent of brand-new boots straight out of the box... It's your favorite pre-match ritual.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_52_DESC: Heading back to the dressing room after the warm-up, someone in the rival crowd shouts your name.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_53_DESC: 'Look at the flags at the top of the stadium... The wind is going to be in your favor today. Believe in it.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_54_DESC: Your favorite track starts playing in the dressing room. Your teammates are catching the rhythm.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_55_DESC: A camera is locked onto your face while you wait in the tunnel. Millions are watching your every blink.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_56_DESC: 'If we win today, you'll never pay for a meal in this city again. Carry that with you!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_57_DESC: The giant clock in the dressing room seems to be ticking louder with every passing second.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_58_DESC: The bright green pitch at the end of the tunnel looks like a dream under the floodlights.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_59_DESC: 'Their striker is a veteran. Watch him, but don't copy him. You have to be your own man out there.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_60_DESC: Applause breaks out from the stands as one of your warm-up strikes rattles the advertising boards.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_61_DESC: 'If you don't honor that shirt today, no one will look you in the eye tomorrow. Be tough!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_62_DESC: The moment you step out, the wall of noise from 80,000 people hits you like a physical blow to the chest.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_63_DESC: 'If we bag an early goal, this stadium will erupt. Give everything in the first 10 minutes!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_64_DESC: Eye-to-eye with the ball on the center spot. It feels like it was waiting for you all along.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_65_DESC: The media says you're just 'lucky' to be in this final. Are you ready to prove them wrong?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_66_DESC: You see the trophy presentation podium being assembled on the sidelines. It's glowing.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_67_DESC: The ref notices your hands are shaking while he checks your studs in the tunnel.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_68_DESC: 'Remember, the thing you're defeating today isn't just the opponent—it's your own limits.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_69_DESC: Warm-up finished. As you head back to the tunnel, the Gaffer gives you a nod. 'I believe in you,' he says.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_70_DESC: The dressing room smells of fresh studs and clean jerseys. Will this be the scent of victory for you?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_71_DESC: 'This stadium will either weep for you or cheer for you today. The decision is in your boots.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_72_DESC: A message from your mate in the National Team: 'Just enjoy the game, ignore the rest.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_73_DESC: The noise from the stands is literally shaking the dust off the dressing room ceiling.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_74_DESC: 'Look at that ball... That ball has to be your best friend today.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_PRE_75_DESC: This is it. The ref puts the whistle to his lips. Hold your breath.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_01_DESC: 'We've secured the upper hand, but don't you dare get comfortable! If this trophy slips through our fingers, no one will remember your flashy football tomorrow. Focus!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_02_DESC: 'Look at that sweat-soaked kit... You fought like a lion out there, kid. But in the second half, they're coming for your ankles. Protect yourself, but don't you dare back down!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_03_DESC: Your highlights from the first half are playing on the locker room TV. The lads are pounding on the tables, keeping time with your name.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_04_DESC: You wince as the doc applies that freezing spray. 'Your pace in the first half has drained your legs. In the second, only your willpower will keep you standing.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_05_DESC: The Gaffer draws a heavy circle around your name on the tactical board. 'The whole world is trying to figure you out now. They'll squeeze you tighter in the second half. Be ready.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_06_DESC: You strip off your drenched jersey and toss it aside. Its weight feels like a physical manifestation of the massive responsibility on your shoulders.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_07_DESC: The Skipper walks over and hands you an ice-cold water bottle: 'Right now, your name is being shouted in every home in the city. You have 45 minutes to turn this dream into reality.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_08_DESC: Dust is falling from the locker room ceiling—a testament to the power of 80,000 fans jumping in unison right above your head.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_09_DESC: 'Listen, kid—their defense knows you now. They'll try every dirty trick and provocation to get you sent off. Do not take the bait!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_10_DESC: The kit man hands you a pungent energy drink. 'Down this, kid. I want your lungs screaming for more in the second half.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_11_DESC: 'That pass in the first half was a work of art. But true greatness is lifting that trophy at the whistle. Don't stop now!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_12_DESC: Furious shouts are echoing from the rival locker room next door. It sounds like our pressure in the first half has turned them against each other.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_13_DESC: You catch your reflection in the mirror. The fire in your eyes, combined with your sweat-soaked face, makes you look like a gladiator mid-battle.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_14_DESC: 'Lads, if anyone thinks this is over just because we're leading, take that shirt off now! The second half is going to be absolute hell!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_15_DESC: The kit man passes by with a steaming cup of tea. In the middle of this high-stakes chaos, the familiar scent feels strangely out of place.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_16_DESC: A teammate from the bench taps your shoulder: 'Your destiny is being written in this very room, right now. Don't slack off, rookie.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_17_DESC: The air in here is thick—an acrid mix of sweat, damp turf, and burning liniment. Even breathing feels like a battle of wills.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_18_DESC: 'You put on quite a show in the first half, and it worked. But play it simpler in the second. Don't give them a chance to break your legs.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_19_DESC: The doc looks at your vitals in shock: 'Your adrenaline is red-lining, but your fitness is incredible. You could play another full match with this energy.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_20_DESC: You kicked off your mud-caked boots. Within seconds, the kit man has placed a fresh, clean pair with razor-sharp studs in front of you.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_21_DESC: 'Can you hear them beyond these walls? They're chanting your name in a roar that won't stop. The opposition doesn't have the breath to silence them.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_22_DESC: The Gaffer wipes the tactical board clean and draws one massive arrow pointed at you: 'The second half belongs to you. Finish this.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_23_DESC: A teammate hugs you for that play where you didn't pass to him: 'Forget it, kid. You got the result. That's all that matters.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_24_DESC: The tactical board is nearly invisible under a layer of chalk dust. The arrows drawn over everyone’s names point to a single word: VICTORY.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_25_DESC: 'That hunger you showed in the first half has set Europe on fire. But true legends are the ones who don't let the tempo drop in the second.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_26_DESC: The physio rubs that burning oil into your thighs to ease the tension. The firmness of his grip wakes your muscles back up for the fight.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_27_DESC: The spare jerseys hanging on metal hooks next to your locker... they look like they're waiting for a fresh weight to be placed on their shoulders.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_28_DESC: 'Their midfield will try to lock you down in the second half. Use your decoy runs to pull them out of position and free up the lads.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_29_DESC: The Skipper walks by and shows his bandaged wrist: 'If I'm out here fighting like this, you with your young blood better make the pitch feel small for them.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_30_DESC: The giant clock on the locker room wall seems to be ticking louder with every second. The time between you and destiny is shrinking.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_31_DESC: 'If we win today, your name will be written in gold across the front pages tomorrow morning. Carry that thought with you!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_32_DESC: The doc wipes the sweat from your brow: 'Pulse is high but you're in the zone. Don't overexert yourself; save some for the final ten.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_33_DESC: A text from your mate in the National Team: 'That first-half performance silenced every critic at the facility. Tear them apart!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_34_DESC: The heavy, metallic, and damp smell of the dressing room hits you. Will this be the scent of victory for the rest of your life?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_35_DESC: 'Every drop of sweat today is a down payment on the tears of joy tomorrow. Are you ready?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_36_DESC: The ref pulls you aside at the tunnel mouth: 'Keep your head, son. I don't want to have to send you off in the second half.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_37_DESC: The moment you dip your bare feet into the bucket of ice water, your whole body shudders from the shock. Your muscles scream back to life.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_38_DESC: 'The rival defense is gasping for air; they've fallen apart. Use your pace in the second half and finish them for good!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_39_DESC: You spot a rival team's scarf forgotten on a bench in the locker room. Someone must have dropped it in fear.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_40_DESC: The Skipper pulls everyone into a huddle, roaring at the top of his lungs: 'ONLY 45 MINUTES LEFT FOR GLORY! DO OR DIE!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_41_DESC: One last look in the mirror, and you see a savage hunger in your eyes that you've never seen before.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_42_DESC: 'Dehydration will kill your game in this humidity. Drink the rest of this; you need to stay sharp out there.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_43_DESC: The backup striker is watching you stretch: 'If you get gassed, just say the word. I'm ready to step in.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_44_DESC: The giant floodlights in the tunnel flickered for a moment. You can hear the deep hum of the generators kicking in.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_45_DESC: 'Listen to that silence in the corridor... In a few minutes, your goal celebrations will shatter it again.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_46_DESC: The Gaffer motivates you one last time: 'They're gassed. Use every ounce of energy in the first ten minutes to break them.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_47_DESC: The noise from the security guards at the door leaks into the room. Everyone is itching to get back out there.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_48_DESC: The kit man drapes a towel over your shoulders: 'You're the one making history today, son. I can feel it.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_49_DESC: Final command for the tunnel walk. The lights in the room seem even brighter now. Ready to walk out?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_POS_50_DESC: You can hear the whistle in the distance. The second half is starting. History is waiting; are you ready to become a legend?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_01_DESC: 'Look at you! You're getting bullied out there! If the weight of this shirt is too much for you, take it off right now—at least we won't be playing with a ghost on the pitch!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_02_DESC: Absolute silence in the dressing room. Only the sound of heavy breathing and the ticking of the wall clock. It feels like everyone is hunting for a scapegoat.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_03_DESC: The Skipper hurled his boot against the wall! 'We can't win by walking! Rookie, why is your flank a bloody highway? Fight for your life out there!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_04_DESC: On the TV, pundits are analyzing your blunder frame by frame. 'He's clearly not ready for this level,' they sneer. The squad watches in grim silence.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_05_DESC: The Gaffer slams his fist onto the tactical board! 'Toss the plan in the bin! If you don't stop playing scared, this trophy will remain a dream!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_06_DESC: The air in the room reeks of sweat and pure disappointment. Every breath you take feels like it's tightening a noose around your chest.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_07_DESC: The doc looks at you with pity while wrapping your leg: 'You're mentally shattered, son. They're going to tear you apart in the second half.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_08_DESC: The ceiling is shuddering. The rival fans upstairs have already started celebrating the win. Their chants are leaking through the concrete.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_09_DESC: 'Look at these lads—their heads are down because of your mistake! Are we going home as heroes tonight, or as traitors?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_10_DESC: The kit man places a cup of water in front of you, but his hand is shaking. The crushing stress in the room has poisoned everyone.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_11_DESC: 'Their striker is laughing at you, can't you see? If you don't put him in his place in the second half, don't even bother looking me in the eye!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_12_DESC: Cheerful laughter and celebration noises are erupting from the rival dressing room next door. It feels like they're targeting you specifically.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_13_DESC: In the mirror, you see the light has gone out of your eyes. You can't stop your hands from trembling.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_14_DESC: 'Lads, if we return to the city with this shame, we won't even make it out of the airport. Rookie, people are betting on your downfall, do you realize that?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_15_DESC: You checked your phone before heading out: 'The fans are turning on each other because of you!' Thousands of hate messages are flooding in.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_16_DESC: The backup striker gives you a nasty smirk while warming up. He looks like he's itching to take your spot and leave you in the dust.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_17_DESC: The humid air in the locker room is sticking to your lungs. The lights feel dimmer and more unsettling than usual.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_18_DESC: 'That pathetic error in the first half dropped our guard! Where do you think you are? Playing a kickabout in the park?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_19_DESC: The doc checks your heart rate and frowns: 'You're in a total panic. Your heart might pack up on the pitch. Be honest with me.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_20_DESC: A stud on your boot has snapped, and the kit man can't find a replacement. 'You'll have to go out like this,' he says grimly.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_21_DESC: 'Can you hear that roar outside? They're waiting to boo you off the pitch. Can you carry that shame?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_22_DESC: The Gaffer wipes the board and puts a giant red X over your name: 'It's not working with you. Get out!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_23_DESC: A teammate grabs you by the collar over a missed pass: 'If you don't play that ball next time, I'll finish you right here!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_24_DESC: Someone has taped over the photo of the trophy on the wall with black tape. A grim message: 'Hope is dead.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_25_DESC: 'The scouts who came to watch you have already closed their notebooks. Your career is circling the drain, rookie.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_26_DESC: The physio tries to work on your cramped calf: 'You're far too tense; your muscles are like granite.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_27_DESC: The spare jerseys hanging on the wall look like they're lining up just to take your place on the pitch.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_28_DESC: 'I don't want to see you on that pitch for the second half, but we're out of subs. Go out there and at least stay on your feet!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_29_DESC: The Skipper squeezes your arm hard at the tunnel mouth, it hurts: 'Either play like a man or suffer the consequences!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_30_DESC: The giant clock in the room feels like it's stopped. Time refuses to pass, and the agonizing wait is breaking you.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_31_DESC: 'If we lose, your name will be 'The Villain of the Night' in this city tomorrow. Get ready for it.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_32_DESC: Doc whispers: 'Your pupils are dilated, you're under extreme stress. You could faint any second.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_33_DESC: A text from your mate in the National Team: 'What's happening? Everyone's slating your mistake.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_34_DESC: The trophy at the tunnel entrance looks so far away now, like it belongs to another world entirely.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_35_DESC: 'Every drop of sweat today is turning into failure. If you don't stop this in the second half, you're finished!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_36_DESC: The ref pulls you aside in the tunnel: 'You're getting reckless. If you don't want me to send you off, calm down.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_37_DESC: Even the water in the ice bucket feels like it's heating up. The fever in the locker room is burning you alive.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_38_DESC: 'The rival defense is playing with you like a cat with a mouse. If you bottle it again, your career is done!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_39_DESC: You spot a torn piece of a boot under the bench. It's yours! Did someone do this on purpose?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_40_DESC: The Skipper pins everyone against the wall: 'THIS IS OUR LAST CHANCE! IF YOU HAVE AN OUNCE OF PRIDE, TURN THIS AROUND!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_41_DESC: Looking in the mirror, you see a stranger staring back. A face filled with fear and desperation.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_42_DESC: 'Your hands are numb from dehydration. If you don't drink this, you won't survive the second half.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_43_DESC: The backup player looks at you with rage: 'We're in this mess because of you! Let me on!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_44_DESC: The lights keep flickering. In the moments of darkness, all you can hear is the Skipper's furious breathing.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_45_DESC: 'Listen to that silence in the tunnel... Soon, that silence will become your executioner. Are you ready?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_46_DESC: The Gaffer: 'They've set a trap for you. Every move you make, they'll bring you down. Watch your back!'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_47_DESC: Heading out, the security guard at the door whispers: 'Destiny is in your hands, kid. Don't fold now.'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_48_DESC: The kit man drapes a towel over you: 'Is this going to be a dark day for you, son?'
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_49_DESC: The light at the end of the tunnel shines like an executioner's blade. There's no choice but to head back out.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_LOC_NEG_50_DESC: The distant whistle echoes. Second half starts now. Either history erases you, or you write history yourself.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_01_START_DESC: You've found space at the edge of the area. The defenders are ignoring you, focused entirely on the star striker. You're invisible to them. What's the move?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_01_START_R: EYES ON THE GOAL AND STRIKE
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_01_START_L: TRY TO MOVE INTO THE GAP

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_02_START_DESC: Chaos in the six-yard box! The ball is bobbling everywhere. It's a total scrap and no one can see a thing. Do you trust your instincts or try to keep your head?

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_05_START_DESC: A brilliant ball over the top. The keeper is off his line but the distance is massive. Do you trust your rookie gut or your technique?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_05_SUC_A_DESC: Absolute thunderbolt! You hit it so hard the stadium went silent for a split second before it rattled the inside of the post. You're a monster!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_05_SUC_B_DESC: Pure class! The ball sailed over the helpless keeper and dropped perfectly into the net. A masterpiece worthy of a final!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_06_START_DESC: The rival striker is clear on your wing. If he gets past, it's a disaster. Clean challenge or take the risk of bringing him down?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_06_SUC_A_DESC: What a tackle! You've nicked the ball perfectly and launched the counter. The fans are cheering like you just scored a worldie.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_06_SUC_B_DESC: Timed to perfection! You took the yellow card but stopped the break. The squad is applauding your 'sacrifice' for the badge.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_07_START_DESC: The rival midfielder has been nipping at your ankles and whispering insults all game. Your patience is at its breaking point.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_07_SUC_A_DESC: He fell for it! The moment he shoved you, you went down. The ref pulls out the RED CARD! They're down to ten men!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_07_SUC_B_DESC: You didn't even blink. While he was busy talking, you found the gap and created a massive chance. Their Gaffer is subbing him off in shame!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_08_START_DESC: Corner incoming. The ball is floating toward the near post and no one is marking you. Technical header or physical leap?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_08_SUC_A_DESC: Clever! A subtle flick sent the keeper the wrong way and the ball into the side netting. Your name is on the big screen!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_08_SUC_B_DESC: What a leap! You rose above everyone and hammered it home. The keeper stood no chance. Is the trophy coming home?

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_09_SUC_B_DESC: You're like the wind! You've left him in the dust, rounded the keeper, and slotted it home. 'The Northern Storm' is too fast today!

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_10_SUC_A_DESC: A STAR IS BORN! No one saw the trajectory. This goal right before the whistle has changed everything!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_10_SUC_B_DESC: The keeper couldn't handle it, it fumbled through his hands! An unbelievable error and the goal we needed! Luck is on your side today.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_11_START_DESC: Dangerous rival counter-attack. It's just you and the keeper left. Take a physical risk to get back or stay composed and wait for a mistake?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_11_SUC_A_DESC: You made it! You threw yourself in front of the ball just as he was about to strike. The keeper is hugging you—you're the hero!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_11_SUC_B_DESC: Your composure rattled him! He couldn't control the ball, the angle narrowed, and he fired wide. Defensive leadership proven.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_12_START_DESC: Set piece won, but the play is static. Do you try something cheeky to catch them off guard or stick to the Skipper's plan?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_12_SUC_A_DESC: Caught them napping! You struck before the wall was set and found the net. The ref awards the goal, and the rivals are fuming!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_12_SUC_B_DESC: Perfect organization! A one-two with the Skipper opened up the space for a clinical finish. Teamwork pays off!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_13_START_DESC: Boxed in by three defenders in a tight spot. Technical brilliance to get out or risk a teammate with a blind pass?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_13_SUC_A_DESC: Through the eye of a needle! You danced through them all and slotted the assist. The stands are chanting your name.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_13_SUC_B_DESC: They didn't expect the pass at all! The ball curved perfectly to your mate—GOAL! What a visionary play!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_14_START_DESC: The Gaffer is screaming from the touchline: 'PRESS! PRESS!' The rival keeper is look a bit casual with the ball at his feet. Going to burn the energy?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_14_SUC_A_DESC: The error was punished! The keeper hesitated, the ball deflected off your boot and into the net! The Boss is applauding your hustle.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_14_SUC_B_DESC: The collective press worked! You forced the error, the Skipper nicked it and scored. You credit the assist for starting the hunt.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_15_START_DESC: A controversial throw-in. The ref gave it to them, but you're certain it came off their defender. Protest or get back into position?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_15_SUC_A_DESC: He changed the call! Your reputation and pressure paid off. It's our throw, and that attack led to a GOAL!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_15_SUC_A_L: I WAS RIGHT! RALLY THE LADS
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_15_SUC_B_DESC: You didn't care. They took the throw, made a mistake, and you nicked the ball for a quick assist! Never switched off.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_16_START_DESC: Angle is tight in the box, and the keeper is closing the gap. Do you try the chip or a powerful low drive?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_16_SUC_A_DESC: Pure power! The ball practically broke the keeper's fingers on the way in. You're a clinical finisher!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_16_SUC_B_DESC: A touch of class! The ball floated over him and nestled in the netting. Europe will be watching this highlight!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_17_START_DESC: Head-to-head for a high ball. It's hanging in the air. Physical dominance or wait and control?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_17_SUC_A_DESC: You own the air! You bullied the defender in the leap and powered a header home. You're a tower!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_17_SUC_B_DESC: Smart! You chested it down, rolled the defender, and laid off the assist. Everyone is stunned by your composure.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_18_START_DESC: The tempo is insane, and everyone is making mistakes. You're about to lose your head. Ride the adrenaline or slow the game down?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_18_SUC_A_DESC: Goal out of chaos! You just hit it, it deflected off a defender and into the net. Fortune favors the rookie today!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_18_SUC_B_DESC: Master of the pitch! You slowed it down, drew the defense out, and carved them open with an assist. Pure Maestro!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_19_START_DESC: The roar of the stands is making your head spin. Take the long shot or play the safe pass?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_19_SUC_A_DESC: No respect for distance! No one thought you'd strike, and it screamed into the top bins. A new legend is born!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_19_SUC_B_DESC: Visionary pass! You drew the press and found the open man. He just tapped it in—GOAL!
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_20_START_DESC: Last play of the half. The rival defender took you down but the ref says play on. Settle the score or get up and keep fighting?
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_20_START_L: GET FIRED UP AND WIN BALL
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_20_SUC_A_DESC: He was terrified of your fury! He backed off, left the gap, and you buried the goal. The squad loved your grit.
LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_20_SUC_B_DESC: What a comeback! You got off the turf, nicked the ball, and fired it home. That's character right there!

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_23_SUC_B_DESC: Your manager applauds from the touchline. You calmed the Skipper and got the team back in the game. That brilliant key pass out of the chaos led straight to a goal!

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_25_SMA_L: ASSIST! WHO IS THE KID NOW

LOK_UCL_PHS0_FH_31_SUC_A_L: GOAL! THAT IS HOW YOU PLAY

LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_13_DESC: IT'S OVER! THE NEW CENTER OF WORLD FOOTBALL! Europe will memorize his name in golden letters tonight!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_14_DESC: FINAL WHISTLE AND ABSOLUTE VICTORY! He silenced the doubters and conquered his enemies! He is the greatest in Europe!

LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_16_DESC: MATCH OVER! TROPHY IN HAND! All that sweat, all that relentless grind shines today in a cup of silver!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_17_DESC: THE WHISTLE BLOWS! EUROPE KNEELS BEFORE HIM! He's not just a footballer anymore; he's the idol of a generation!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_18_DESC: IT'S OVER! THE COLOR OF VICTORY IS SILVER! In the heart of the stadium, on the grandest stage the world is watching, he proved he is the best!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_19_DESC: TITLE SECURED! The whistle blows, the war is over. The media army rushes toward him. He is the sole ruler of this night!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_VIC_20_DESC: FINAL WHISTLE! YOU WON! CHAMPION! This is no dream, this is your masterpiece! You are the undisputed number one in Europe!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_01_DESC: You're on the open-top bus. The sea of people is chanting your name. The city officially bows to its new king!

LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_04_DESC: A celebrity barber flew in on a private jet just to give you the 'champion's cut'. Your new style is an instant global trend!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_05_DESC: Your sponsor projected a massive 3D hologram of you lifting the trophy onto the city's tallest skyscraper. The world is watching.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_06_DESC: You're the main guest on the biggest global late-night show. The host introduces you as 'The Hundred Million Euro Man'.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_07_DESC: Flying back on the club's private jet, the President raises a glass of champagne exclusively to your flawless performance.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_08_DESC: The entire capital is draped in your squad number. Your personal brand has completely taken over the city streets.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_09_DESC: You bought the old concrete pitch from your childhood and transformed it into a massive football academy bearing your name.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_10_DESC: Dozens of fans are waiting outside your mansion, proudly showing off fresh tattoos of your face.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_11_DESC: You hosted an ultra-exclusive VIP gala for your family and friends. Gold-leaf steaks and caviar are on the menu.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_12_DESC: The club board has decided to build a massive statue of you right outside the stadium, next to the absolute legends!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_13_DESC: You gained ten million followers overnight. Global pop stars and Hollywood actors are sliding into your DMs.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_14_DESC: Naming newborns after you has become a national trend. You are single-handedly changing the country's demographics.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_15_DESC: An entire wing of the club museum is now dedicated solely to your season. You are the main exhibit.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_16_DESC: You launched your own global sportswear brand. It sold out completely within three minutes of the final whistle!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_17_DESC: Police escorts are helpless against the millions of fans swarming your convoy. It's absolute superstar madness!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_18_DESC: Elite managers from rival mega-clubs are texting you congratulations, secretly trying to lure you away.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_19_DESC: A massive billboard in Times Square features your face lifting the Champions League trophy. You've gone truly global.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_20_DESC: The Prime Minister invites you to the presidential palace. You are welcomed not just as a player, but as state royalty.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_21_DESC: You flew a group of disabled fans to the final on your private jet. Now you're celebrating on the pitch with them.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_22_DESC: A luxury watchmaker created a one-of-a-kind timepiece worth millions just to commemorate your winning goal.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_23_DESC: A chart-topping rap artist just dropped a brand new track entirely about your lavish lifestyle and that winning goal.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_24_DESC: Top-tier fashion houses are naming their new exclusive collections after you. You are the ultimate trendsetter.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_25_DESC: You bought out an entire luxury island resort to throw a week-long celebration for your closest friends.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_26_DESC: You hosted your own elite charity gala. Billionaires are bidding absolute fortunes just for your match-worn boots.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_27_DESC: No passport lines for you. The VIP terminal is cleared out, and a fleet of black SUVs is waiting right on the tarmac.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_28_DESC: The board officially announced that your jersey number will be retired forever the day you hang up your boots!
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_29_DESC: The club president hands you a blank cheque for your contract extension live on camera. You write your own price.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_30_DESC: Sipping coffee on your mega-yacht as the sun rises. The Champions League trophy gleams on the table. The world is yours.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_01_DESC: Dead silence on the team bus. The fans outside are glaring at you with pure anger. Everyone knows the most expensive player gets the blame.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_02_DESC: You hold the silver medal. For a hundred-million-euro star, second place just means you're the first loser. This piece of metal burns your hands.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_03_DESC: An army of reporters swarms you at the airport. 'How do you explain this fiasco despite the massive budget?' they shout.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_04_DESC: The roads are empty as you return to your luxury mansion. The massive area prepared for your victory party is now swallowed in darkness.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_05_DESC: The morning headlines are ruthless: 'The 100 Million Euro Disappointment!' All the criticism is laser-focused on you.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_06_DESC: You drive past an angry mob of fans at the facility gates. 'Earn your paycheck!' they scream, banging on your car.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_07_DESC: You went to a restaurant to clear your head, but everyone is pointing and whispering. The weight of fame has never felt so heavy.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_08_DESC: Your agent calls: 'The sponsors are grumbling. We need an urgent PR campaign to fix your image.'
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_09_DESC: Your family comes down from the VIP box to console you. 'You did your best,' they say, but all you can think about is the lost cup.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_10_DESC: You threw the silver medal into the back of your safe. That cursed object only reminds you of millions of broken hearts.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_11_DESC: The rival star posts a photo with the cup and tags you: 'Maybe you'll get lucky next year.'
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_12_DESC: You watch your massive promotional posters being torn down around the stadium in the rain. Losers don't stay on the walls.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_13_DESC: A teenager stops you on the street: 'I saved my allowance to buy your shirt. You didn't even show up last night.'
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_14_DESC: You called your private coach at midnight and headed to the pitch. The only way to erase that defeat is to train until your feet bleed.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_15_DESC: The Club President calls you into his office. 'We invested a fortune in you. Is this the return we get?' he demands.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_16_DESC: The silence at the facility is eating your brain. While the world talks about your downfall, you look for a way out on this empty pitch.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_17_DESC: Your private barber breaks the silence: 'Everyone is criticizing you, bro, but you'll bounce back next year.' The pity annoys you.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_18_DESC: You have to attend a scheduled charity event. Forcing a smile for the cameras while you're gutted feels like pure torture.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_19_DESC: The Skipper approaches you at training: 'Understand the weight of this club now? When we lose, the most expensive guy foots the bill.'
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_20_DESC: Looking out over the city from your penthouse balcony. This city will either swallow you whole, or you'll conquer it from the ashes.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_21_DESC: Legendary former players on TV are debating if you lack the 'big game' mentality. The criticism cuts like a knife.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_22_DESC: Walking past the club museum, you spot the empty display case. A trophy with your name was supposed to be there.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_23_DESC: The hashtag 'The Bubble Burst' is trending number one. Millions are mocking you online.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_24_DESC: Your main sponsor is considering suspending your ad campaign. Losing isn't just hurting your pride; it's burning your wealth.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_25_DESC: You're flying into tackles during training. You can't control the massive rage inside you; everyone is terrified of you.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_26_DESC: The media expects a public apology. Stepping in front of the cameras to own this disaster is the ultimate test of leadership.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_27_DESC: You drafted a statement to the fans: 'I owe you one. I will settle this debt next season.'
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_28_DESC: You met with the club's academy players. The youngsters are watching to see how you rise from this colossal fall.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_29_DESC: As you leave the facility, fanatic fans block your supercar: 'Play for the badge, not for the money!' they scream.
LOK_UCL_PHS1_AFTER_DEF_30_DESC: A new sun rises. A star fell last night, but a legend can be born tomorrow. The pinnacle of Europe is still waiting.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_01_DESC: 75th minute, deadlock. The Boss subs you on: 'Go break them down, kid!' Your legs are shaking.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_02_DESC: The veteran center-back is screaming at you for not tracking back! Cameras are rolling. What's your move?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_03_DESC: Their hardman defender intentionally stepped on your ankle. 'Welcome to the big leagues, kid,' he smirks.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_04_DESC: When you get the ball, the home crowd buzzes. They want a piece of magic from you.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_05_DESC: The Gaffer is shouting tactical changes from the touchline, but it's too loud to hear. Improvise?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_06_DESC: It's pouring rain. The pitch is a swamp, making dribbling almost impossible.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_07_DESC: The ball falls to your weak foot. Adjusting will let the defense close in. You have seconds.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_08_DESC: The team is sitting deep, but their keeper took a heavy touch. Do you waste energy pressing alone?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_09_DESC: Crucial free-kick. The star player grabs the ball, but you know you have a better angle.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_10_DESC: You made a rookie mistake, losing the ball. They are countering fast! You need to sprint back.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_11_DESC: Tough away game. The crowd boos you every time you touch the ball, trying to get in your head.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_12_DESC: 60th minute and you're exhausted. Your lungs are burning. Signal the bench?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_13_DESC: One-on-one with the keeper! But a veteran teammate is open for a tap-in. Glory or the team?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_14_DESC: You reach the byline. Giant defenders and your striker are in the box. Cross immediately?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_15_DESC: A loose ball in midfield. You and their tank-like midfielder are sprinting toward it.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_16_DESC: Coach gave you a special task: 'Man-mark their playmaker. Don't let him breathe.'
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_17_DESC: A high ball drops from the sky. It's tough to control, and the whole stadium is watching your first touch.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_18_DESC: Penalty! Your teammate was fouled. Everyone is looking around. Will you step up?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_19_DESC: Rival defender whispers: 'Who even are you, kid? Never heard of you.' He wants you angry.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_20_DESC: The keeper fumbled a long shot! The ball is loose in the box. Time to be a poacher.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_21_DESC: Rumor has it scouts from a European giant are in the stands. Time to show off?
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_22_DESC: The Skipper plays a terrible pass toward the touchline. If you don't reach it, the attack dies.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_23_DESC: You see your number on the sub board. Two minutes left before you come off.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_24_DESC: The team parked the bus to protect the lead. You're alone up front and get the ball.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_25_DESC: You beat one man, but two more defenders are closing in fast. No support.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_26_DESC: Coach changes tactics mid-game and sends you to the opposite wing where you're not used to playing.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_27_DESC: You took a heavy foul but the ref says 'Play on'. They have the ball and are breaking.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_28_DESC: It started snowing. The ball is sticking to the grass. Your usual style won't work.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_29_DESC: Fast break! You're the quickest runner, but the pass is played slightly behind you.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_30_DESC: You get the ball in your own half. The fans urge you to do a trick.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_31_DESC: You receive the ball in midfield and notice the keeper is far off his line. It's a long way.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_32_DESC: A cross comes in, but it's too high. If you stretch, you might reach it, but a defender is flying in.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_33_DESC: An opponent mocks your rookie salary: 'My car is worth more than your contract.'
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_34_DESC: Final minutes, we're winning. The Skipper signals you to take it to the corner flag.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_35_DESC: You're in the wall for a free-kick. The ball is blasted straight toward your face.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_36_DESC: After a sudden sprint, you feel a slight pull in your hamstring. We're on a critical attack.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_37_DESC: You're 1v1 with a legendary defender you've idolized since childhood. His poster is in your room.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_38_DESC: A ball drops in the box, but a defender's boot is dangerously high. You could head it.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_39_DESC: You made a very simple control error and the ball went out. A massive groan from the home fans.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_GEN_40_DESC: Last seconds, match is drawn. The ball falls to you at the edge of the box. This shot decides the game.

LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_02_DESC: A SCRAPPY GOAL! Maybe not pretty, but this hunger will take him far. It's in the net!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_03_DESC: WHAT A SOLO GOAL! He dances past them all and finishes it. This kid is a star in the making!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_04_DESC: FLAWLESS ASSIST! Put it right on a plate for him! What incredible football IQ for someone so young!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_05_DESC: HUSTLE BRINGS THE ASSIST! He won a lost cause and set up the goal. That's character right there!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_06_DESC: PINPOINT CROSS! Whipped it in so perfectly the striker just had to nod it. Great work!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_07_DESC: NO WAY THROUGH! He stepped in at a critical moment to deny a certain goal. Defending like a wall despite his age!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_08_DESC: BRILLIANT POSITIONING! He read the danger perfectly and intercepted. Very smart play!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_09_DESC: PHYSICAL DOMINANCE! He outmuscled the veteran defender. This kid is incredibly strong!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_10_DESC: THE BOSS IS APPLAUDING! The bench acknowledges his fantastic effort. Great shift today!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_11_DESC: PRAISE FROM THE CAPTAIN! The leader of the pitch pats him on the head. He's earning their trust.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_12_DESC: THE FANS CHANT HIS NAME! This young talent is well on his way to becoming a fan favorite.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_13_DESC: A BIT OF LUCK! The ball bounced kindly for him. Sometimes in football, you just need luck on your side.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_14_DESC: WON THE MIND GAMES! He rattled his opponent and forced an error. Very cunning play!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_SUC_15_DESC: LUNGS OF STEEL! It's the end of the match but he's sprinting like it's minute one. Unbelievable stamina!
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_01_DESC: NO! An unbelievable miss! He sends it into the stands. The Boss is pulling his hair out.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_02_DESC: WHAT A SAVE! The shot was good, but the keeper pulls off a miracle.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_03_DESC: OFF THE POST! Great strike, but that cruel metallic sound echoes around the stadium. Unlucky.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_04_DESC: POOR PASS! Good idea, terrible execution. The defense read it easily.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_05_DESC: OUT OF BOUNDS! A mix-up with his teammate and the ball rolls out for a throw.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_06_DESC: BEATEN TOO EASILY! The attacker skips past him without breaking a sweat, exposing the defense.

LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_08_DESC: YELLOW CARD! Victim of his own inexperience. The ref books him without hesitation.

LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_13_DESC: A ROASTING FROM THE BOSS! The whole stadium heard the manager screaming at him. He might be coming off.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_14_DESC: THE CAPTAIN IS LIVID! After that rookie error, the Skipper gets right in his face. It's going to be a tough dressing room.
LOK_MATCH_PHS0_FAIL_15_DESC: THE CROWD GROANS! Even his own fans couldn't stomach that amateur mistake and have started to whistle.
LOK_P0_TRANS_01_DESC: Approaching the stadium on the team bus. Your favorite music is playing in your headphones. The energy of the fans outside bleeds through the windows.
LOK_P0_TRANS_02_DESC: Putting on your jersey in the locker room. As a rookie, you notice your hands trembling slightly from the nerves.
LOK_P0_TRANS_03_DESC: Pre-match meeting. The Gaffer points to your zone on the tactical board: 'Keep this area locked down tight.'
LOK_P0_TRANS_04_DESC: Pitch inspection in your tracksuits. The grass is freshly watered and looks a bit slick.
LOK_P0_TRANS_05_DESC: A reporter shoves a microphone in your face outside the facility: 'Expecting to get some minutes today, young man?'
LOK_P0_TRANS_06_DESC: The Skipper rallies the room before kick-off: 'No one slacks today! We cover for each other out there!'
LOK_P0_TRANS_07_DESC: The physio rubs that burning muscle cream onto your legs. The whole room smells strongly of deep heat.
LOK_P0_TRANS_08_DESC: Sitting in the locker room, you see you've been handed a sub's bib instead of a starting shirt. You're on the bench.
LOK_P0_TRANS_09_DESC: During warm-ups, the veteran striker barks at you: 'Play the ball into my run, not to my feet.'
LOK_P0_TRANS_10_DESC: While warming up, your eyes scan the stands for your family or friends. You know they're out there.
LOK_P0_TRANS_11_DESC: Lining up in the tunnel. The opposing center-back looks over and gives you a patronizing smirk.
LOK_P0_TRANS_12_DESC: The referee checks your studs in the tunnel. 'No rough stuff today, kid,' he winks.
LOK_P0_TRANS_13_DESC: Minutes before kick-off. The massive roar from the stands is ringing in your ears.
LOK_P0_TRANS_14_DESC: As you put on your shirt, you realize they misspelled your name on the back. The struggles of a rookie.
LOK_P0_TRANS_15_DESC: The Coach pulls you aside: 'If you have a good game today, the shirt is yours permanently. Take your chance.'
LOK_P0_TRANS_16_DESC: A light, rainy evening. The floodlights reflect off the slick grass. Perfect weather for football.
LOK_P0_TRANS_17_DESC: Your touch is a bit heavy during passing drills. You misplaced a few balls. Need to shake off the nerves.
LOK_P0_TRANS_18_DESC: The keeper walks up to you in the corridor: 'You're covering the near post on corners, don't lose your man.'
LOK_P0_TRANS_19_DESC: In a quick pre-match interview, a reporter asks: 'Can you handle the pressure at such a young age?'
LOK_P0_TRANS_20_DESC: The Skipper gathers everyone for the traditional pre-match prayer and huddle.
LOK_P0_TRANS_21_DESC: Leaving the hotel, you see fans sending off the bus with flares. The city is locked in for this match.
LOK_P0_TRANS_22_DESC: While warming up, you notice the assistant coach taking notes on you. You might just start today.
LOK_P0_TRANS_23_DESC: Everyone has a pre-match superstition in the locker room. You quietly perform your own little ritual.
LOK_P0_TRANS_24_DESC: Sitting on the bench, you realize you're tapping your feet to the rhythm of the fans' chants.
LOK_P0_TRANS_25_DESC: The Gaffer is going over set pieces on the board. He's got you assigned as the 'draft excluder' lying behind the wall.
LOK_P0_TRANS_26_DESC: The national anthem plays. You close your eyes and remember the days you dreamed of this exact moment.
LOK_P0_TRANS_27_DESC: The star player sitting next to your locker turns to you and says, 'Good luck out there, kid.'
LOK_P0_TRANS_28_DESC: As the bus pulls into the away stadium, rival fans start booing heavily. The noise is intimidating.
LOK_P0_TRANS_29_DESC: You do a quick sprint on the pitch just before kick-off. Your legs feel surprisingly fresh today.
LOK_P0_TRANS_30_DESC: The stadium announcer mispronounces your name while reading the starting XI. The perks of being a rookie.

LOK_P0_MAG_02_L_FAIL: You are famous! Your rude rejection caused the influencer to start a hate campaign against you.

LOK_P0_MAG_03_R_FAIL: You lack focus! A match poster in the background exposed your lie. The coach is furious.

LOK_P0_MAG_03_L_FAIL: Fans hate you already. They brought 'Fat Rookie' banners to the stadium.
